title: DebugLM: Learning Traceable Training Data Provenance for LLMs
authors_zh: Wenjie Jacky Mo、Qin Liu、Xiaofei Wen、Wenxuan Zhou、Zhe Zhao、Muhao Chen
paper_type_zh: 训练内溯源与修复配方
best_for_zh: 关注训练数据谱系、安全修复、模型自报和审计边界的研究者
one_line: DebugLM augments ordinary post-training records with dataset-level provenance and quarantine labels so a trained model can self-report a source tag or selectively refuse source-associated behavior.
DebugLM 用数据集级溯源与隔离标签增强 SFT/GRPO 记录，使模型能自报来源或针对来源选择性拒答。
why: It is a concrete construction pattern for carrying source identity through post-training into deployment-time diagnosis, while exposing the audit gap between a trained self-report and independently replayable lineage.
inclusion_reason: DebugLM makes dataset provenance part of the post-training record and model output through explicit source tags, then converts the same labels into a tracing and selective-refusal interface across sequential instruction tuning and GRPO stages.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official arXiv record identifies this work as arXiv:2603.17884v1, submitted on 18 March 2026. DebugLM addresses a provenance gap in heterogeneous, multi-stage post-training: after a model exhibits an unwanted behavior, a developer may observe the output but cannot directly identify which source dataset or training stage taught the behavior. The paper therefore treats debugging as source diagnosis and source-level quarantine, not as iterative program repair. (Paper §1; arXiv record)

The data unit is an instruction-response record paired with a known dataset identity. It is not a multi-step debugging episode: there are no action-observation turns, tool calls, execution traces, environment states, or persisted failure-and-retry sequence. The proposed output is a learned source tag attached to a response, and the proposed intervention is a standardized refusal conditioned on a selected source tag.

This scope is operationally useful but narrower than causal attribution. A tag records the source label used during construction and tests whether the trained model can reproduce that label. It does not independently prove that one particular training record caused one particular generation. The work belongs to Data Construction & Open-Release Recipes because provenance, mode, and quarantine controls are added while task records pass through sequential SFT and GRPO. The bilingual Card is L4_chinese_review_ready, while its release remains partial: the paper is sufficient for mechanism and evidence review, but no official code, transformed records, checkpoints, or immutable stage manifest were confirmed.

arXiv 官方记录将本文标为 arXiv:2603.17884v1，提交日期为 2026 年 3 月 18 日。DebugLM 处理异构、多阶段后训练中的来源断链问题：模型出现不良行为后，开发者能看到输出，却往往无法直接判断该行为来自哪个训练数据集或哪个训练阶段。因此，论文中的调试是来源诊断与来源级隔离，而不是反复执行程序、定位并修复代码。（论文 §1；arXiv 记录）

其数据单元是带已知数据集身份的指令—回答记录,并非多步调试 episode:记录中没有动作—观察轮次、工具调用、执行轨迹、环境状态,也没有持久化的失败—重试序列。方法学习的是在回答后输出来源标签,并在指定某个来源标签时执行标准化拒答。

这一范围具有操作价值，但比因果归因更窄。标签表达构造时赋予的来源身份，并检验训练后模型能否复现该身份；它不能独立证明某条训练记录导致了某次具体生成。本文属于 Data Construction & Open-Release Recipes，因为 provenance、mode 与 quarantine 控制被加入顺序 SFT 和 GRPO 经过的任务记录中。双语 Card 已达到 L4_chinese_review_ready，但发布状态仍为 partial：论文足以支持机制和证据审查，尚未确认官方代码、转换记录、checkpoint 或不可变 stage manifest。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DebugLM converts provenance from external documentation into supervised fields inside post-training records. Every source receives a dedicated single-token tag. For each instruction-response pair, an ordinary variant retains the original answer, while a diagnostic variant adds the paper's DEBUG trigger to the input and appends the source tag to the target. A weighted objective trains both modes so ordinary use need not expose the diagnostic field.

The same tag vocabulary also defines a control channel. A remediation example pairs a record with a sampled quarantine tag. If that control tag equals the record's true source, the target is a standardized refusal; otherwise the target remains the ordinary answer. At deployment, a developer can request source reporting or ask the model to suppress behavior associated with one labeled source.

The resulting feedback contract is label-based rather than execution-based. Provenance supervision comes from known dataset membership, and remediation supervision comes from an equality test between the source tag and control tag. The paper reports no executor, runtime observation, patch verifier, or environmental reward for deciding whether a debugging step repaired a failure.

DebugLM 把原本只存在于外部文档中的来源信息改造成后训练记录里的监督字段。每个来源分配一个独立的单 token 标签;对每条指令—回答记录,普通变体保留原回答,诊断变体在输入中加入论文定义的 DEBUG 触发符,并在目标末尾附加来源标签。加权目标同时训练两种模式,使普通使用无需暴露诊断字段。

同一套标签还构成控制通道。修复样本会把记录与一个抽样得到的隔离标签配对:若隔离标签等于记录的真实来源,目标改为标准化拒答;否则仍学习原回答。部署时,开发者可以请求来源自报,也可以要求模型抑制与某个已标记来源相关的行为。

这里的反馈契约基于标签,而非程序执行。来源监督来自已知的数据集成员关系,修复监督来自来源标签与控制标签是否相等。论文没有报告用于判断某个调试步骤是否修复失败的执行器、运行时观察、补丁验证器或环境奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins from five existing datasets. Stage 1 instruction-tunes Llama-3-8B and Qwen-3-8B on a mixture of TOFU, ChatDoctor, TruthfulQA, and Beavertails. Stage 2 then applies GRPO on WMDP. Dataset identity supplies the provenance label; the paper adds ordinary, diagnostic-tagged, and control-tagged targets around the existing instruction-response content. The ordinary-to-diagnostic mixture, control-tag sampling distribution, filtering rule, tracing-loss weight, optimizer settings, batch sizes, epochs, and Stage 2 reward implementation are unknown.

The evaluation verifier is explicit. Tracing Success Rate is exact-match accuracy against the known source tag on held-out sets. The remediation intervention matrix checks whether the model refuses inputs from a requested quarantine source while continuing to answer other sources. Free-form utility is judged by Llama-3-70B-Instruct; WMDP and standard academic benchmarks use exact match. These are response-level checks, not execution feedback from a stateful environment.

The main diagnostic call has a one-forward-pass endpoint: produce the answer and its tag. A separate QuoteSum experiment builds 1,254 cases by using GPT-4o-mini to derive isolated single-source QA pairs, then evaluates comprehensive questions that require two sources. Training still asks for one tag per sequence; evaluation draws ten outputs at temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95 and declares success only if every relevant tag appears at least once. This is a sampled aggregation rule, not a stored multi-step episode.

The paper also tests finer labels by replacing dataset tags with 199 TOFU author tags and 14 Beavertails toxicity-subcategory tags. A semantic-perturbation evaluation uses Llama-3.1-70B to extract atomic facts and synthesize new QA records from 576 held-out TOFU development instances. These teacher-generated records belong to separate evaluation studies and should not be conflated with the main five-dataset training mixture.

构造从五个已有数据集出发。阶段 1 在 TOFU、ChatDoctor、TruthfulQA 与 Beavertails 的混合数据上对 Llama-3-8B 和 Qwen-3-8B 做指令微调;阶段 2 再在 WMDP 上执行 GRPO。数据集身份提供来源标签,论文围绕原有指令—回答内容构造普通目标、带诊断标签的目标以及带控制标签的目标。普通与诊断样本比例、控制标签抽样分布、筛选规则、追踪损失权重、优化器设置、batch size、epoch 数和阶段 2 奖励实现均为 unknown。

评估判定方式较明确。Tracing Success Rate 在留出集上以来源标签的 Exact Match 计算;修复干预矩阵检查模型是否只对被指定隔离的来源拒答,同时继续回答其他来源。自由生成任务由 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 评判,WMDP 与通用学术基准采用 Exact Match。这些都是回答级检查,并非有状态环境返回的执行反馈。

主诊断接口的终点是一次前向计算后生成回答及标签。另一个 QuoteSum 实验用 GPT-4o-mini 构造 1,254 个单来源问答,再用需要综合两个来源的问题评估。训练时每个序列仍只学习一个标签;评估以 temperature 1.0、top-p 0.95 采样 10 次,只有全部相关标签至少出现一次才记为成功。这是多次采样后的聚合判据,不是被保存的多步 episode。

论文还把数据集标签替换为 199 个 TOFU 作者标签和 14 个 Beavertails 有害类别标签,以测试更细粒度的来源区分。语义扰动评估则用 Llama-3.1-70B 从 576 个留出的 TOFU 开发集实例中抽取原子事实并合成新问答。这些教师生成记录属于独立评估研究,不能与主实验的五数据集训练混合混为一谈。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the five-source held-out evaluation, DebugLM reports macro Tracing Success Rate of 95.89% for Llama-3-8B and 95.68% for Qwen-3-8B. The dedicated 1B post-hoc classifiers reach 97.95% and 98.57%, respectively, so the result supports a compact in-model interface but does not show that self-reporting is universally more accurate than an external classifier. The intervention matrices show near-perfect targeted refusal and near-zero off-target refusal in the studied source domains.

The paper probes several boundaries: format conversion to two-choice questions, 199-author and 14-subcategory lineage, semantic perturbation on 576 held-out TOFU instances, and two-source QuoteSum synthesis. Under the ten-sample success rule, multi-source tracing reaches 99.60% for the Llama-based model and 99.76% for the Qwen-based model. Because this criterion aggregates stochastic outputs, it is not equivalent to recovering all sources in one deterministic response.

Utility evidence is mixed. Table 5 reports the Llama-based model falling from 58.57% to 52.11% on MMLU and from 79.18% to 73.55% on ARC-Challenge; the Qwen-based drops are smaller. Free-form utility additionally depends on one model judge, with no reported human calibration or inter-judge analysis.

These benchmark results evaluate trained behavior, not the quality, coverage, licensing, or replayability of the constructed records. No official code, transformed dataset, checkpoint, stage manifest, or failure log was confirmed, so independent reproduction of the reported construction pipeline remains unsupported by released artifacts.

在五来源留出评估中,DebugLM 的宏平均 Tracing Success Rate 在 Llama-3-8B 上为 95.89%,在 Qwen-3-8B 上为 95.68%。专门训练的 1B 事后分类器分别达到 97.95% 和 98.57%,因此结果支持"把接口放进模型"的紧凑性,却不能说明模型自报在所有情况下都比外部分类型更准确。论文中的干预矩阵在所研究来源上呈现接近完全的定向拒答和接近零的非目标拒答。

论文还测试了多项边界:把格式改成二选一题、199 个作者标签、14 个有害子类别标签、576 个留出 TOFU 实例上的语义扰动,以及双来源 QuoteSum 综合。在"采样 10 次且所有相关标签都至少出现一次"的判据下,Llama 版本和 Qwen 版本的多来源追踪率分别为 99.60% 与 99.76%。由于该指标聚合随机输出,它不等于单次确定性回答就恢复全部来源。

效用证据并不完全单向。表 5 中,Llama 版本在 MMLU 上从 58.57% 降到 52.11%,在 ARC-Challenge 上从 79.18% 降到 73.55%;Qwen 版本降幅较小。自由生成效用还依赖单一模型裁判,论文未报告人工校准或多裁判一致性分析。

这些基准结果检验训练后行为,不等于构造记录在质量、覆盖、许可或可回放性上已得到证明。尚未确认官方代码、变换后数据、检查点、阶段清单或失败日志,因此公开制品不足以支持独立复现整条构造流水线。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The central contribution is a proactive provenance contract: source identity is bound to task records during training and can be requested alongside generation later. This differs from static dataset documentation, retrieval over stored training text, or post-hoc influence estimation because the final model learns an explicit source-label interface as part of optimization.

DebugLM also reuses the source vocabulary for deployment control. The same label that supports diagnosis can condition a source-targeted refusal, connecting a construction-time field to an observable action. Fine-grained and multi-source experiments explore how far this interface can move beyond one dataset-one tag.

The novelty should not be overstated. The model is trained to self-report curator-supplied labels; the paper does not cryptographically bind those reports to immutable records, authenticate the training run, or replay a failure through an execution environment. Its contribution is a learned diagnostic and control schema, not independently verified causal lineage.

核心贡献是一种前置来源契约:训练时把来源身份绑定到任务记录,部署后再让模型随生成结果返回该身份。它不同于静态数据卡、对存档训练文本做检索或事后估计影响度,因为最终模型在优化过程中直接学习了显式的来源标签接口。

DebugLM 还把同一套来源词表用于部署控制。支持诊断的标签也能触发面向特定来源的拒答,从而把构造阶段字段连接到可观察动作。细粒度与多来源实验则探索这一接口能否超出"一数据集一标签"的基本设置。

这项新意不能被扩张为更强结论。模型学习的是策展者提供的标签;论文没有把自报结果与不可变记录做密码学绑定,没有认证训练过程,也没有通过执行环境回放失败。其贡献是训练得到的诊断与控制模式,而非经过独立验证的因果血缘。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
DebugLM requires control of training and prior knowledge of the source mixture; it cannot be retrofitted to an already frozen service. Dataset-level labels are coarse, while overlapping or derivative datasets may not admit one unambiguous true source. Emitting one tag per sequence also makes multi-source tracing depend on repeated sampling, temperature, and a permissive aggregate success rule.

The reported record is not a full debugging episode. It preserves no action-observation trajectory, executor output, exception or test trace, patch candidate, retry history, or runtime terminal state. A refusal is a trained target, not evidence that an underlying defect was repaired. The paper likewise releases no structured failure record linking an observed bad output to its tag, selected quarantine, post-intervention response, and replay result.

Replayability is weak. Official code, checkpoints, transformed records, source revision hashes, stage manifests, full split counts, filtering rules, loss weight, optimizer configuration, batch sizes, epochs, and the Stage 2 GRPO reward implementation were not confirmed. Decontamination and compatibility among upstream dataset licenses are also unknown.

Security and validity remain open. A later fine-tuner could erase or spoof tag behavior; a developer trigger creates an access-control surface; and the model's self-report is not authenticated against external lineage logs. Scaling to many overlapping tags may introduce capacity or interference effects. Benchmark scores, including strong tracing results, do not resolve these audit risks or establish record-level causality.

DebugLM 需要控制训练过程并预先知道数据来源混合,无法事后安装到已经冻结的服务中。数据集级标签较粗,而相互重叠或派生的数据集未必存在唯一无歧义的真实来源。每个序列只输出一个标签,也使多来源追踪依赖重复采样、temperature 和较宽松的聚合成功定义。

论文记录并不是完整的调试 episode。它不保存动作—观察轨迹、执行器输出、异常或测试轨迹、补丁候选、重试历史或运行时终止状态。拒答只是训练目标,并不能证明底层缺陷已经修复。论文也没有发布结构化失败记录,把异常输出、来源标签、隔离选择、干预后回答与回放结果连在一起。

可回放性较弱。尚未确认官方代码、检查点、变换后记录、来源版本哈希、阶段清单、完整 split 数量、筛选规则、损失权重、优化器配置、batch size、epoch 数和阶段 2 GRPO 奖励实现。去污染流程与上游数据许可之间的兼容性同样为 unknown。

安全性与有效性仍有开放问题。后续微调可能抹除或伪造标签行为;开发者触发符带来访问控制风险;模型自报也没有和外部血缘日志做认证。大量重叠标签还可能产生容量压力或相互干扰。包括高追踪率在内的基准分数不能消除这些审计风险,也不能建立逐记录因果关系。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction and open-release-recipes track, DebugLM is useful as a schema rather than as a ready-to-download corpus. A curator can attach immutable source IDs and stage membership to each task record, generate ordinary, diagnostic, and quarantine-conditioned variants, and then test whether those fields survive sequential SFT and RLVR. The paper also provides negative audit guidance: provenance should remain a first-class training field instead of being reconstructed only after a failure.

An auditable implementation should publish the transformed records, exact upstream revisions and licenses, deterministic construction scripts, source-to-tag registry, stage manifests, training configuration, and evaluation code. It should retain a failure table containing the input, output, emitted source tag, requested quarantine, observed refusal or answer, evaluator result, and rerun identifier. External lineage logs should be compared with model self-reports.

If this pattern is extended to code or agent data, the episode schema must add actions, observations, executor versions, execution feedback, artifacts, and explicit success and termination predicates; those fields are not supplied by DebugLM itself. Until official reusable artifacts appear, the paper supports recipe analysis and audit design, not an independently replayable open-data release.

对数据构造与开放发布配方这一 track 而言,DebugLM 更适合作为数据模式,而不是可直接下载的语料。策展者可以给每条任务记录绑定不可变来源 ID 与训练阶段,生成普通、诊断和隔离条件变体,再检验这些字段能否穿过顺序 SFT 与 RLVR。论文还提供了一条反向审计启示:来源信息应成为一等训练字段,而不应等到失败后才尝试重建。

可审计实现应公开变换后记录、精确的上游版本与许可、确定性构造脚本、来源—标签注册表、阶段清单、训练配置和评估代码。失败表至少应保存输入、输出、自报来源标签、请求隔离的来源、实际拒答或回答、评估结果及重跑标识;同时应使用外部血缘日志核对模型自报。

若把这一模式扩展到代码或智能体数据,episode 模式还必须加入动作、观察、执行器版本、执行反馈、产物以及明确的成功与终止判据;这些字段并不是 DebugLM 已提供的内容。在官方可复用制品出现前,该论文适合支持配方分析与审计设计,而不能视为已经可独立回放的开放数据发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Data object: instruction-response records plus source, mode, control, target, and stage labels; not a stateful debugging episode.
  • Feedback: known-source exact match for tracing, tag equality for refusal supervision, a model judge for free-form utility, and no reported execution feedback.
  • Terminal predicates: one response-and-tag endpoint for the main interface; all relevant tags across ten samples for multi-source evaluation; no episodic stop condition.
  • Failure and replay audit: no official per-failure records, transformed corpus, code, checkpoint, immutable source revisions, or full configuration were confirmed.
  • Interpretation: strong tracing or refusal scores evaluate the learned interface and must not be treated as proof of data quality, causal lineage, or open-release completeness.
  • Track use: the work supplies a provenance-aware construction recipe and an audit checklist, but not a replayable released dataset.

• 数据对象:指令—回答记录,加上来源、模式、控制、目标与训练阶段标签;它不是有状态的调试 episode。
  • 反馈契约:来源追踪用已知标签 Exact Match,拒答监督用标签相等判断,自由生成效用依赖模型裁判;未报告执行反馈。
  • 终止判据:主接口以一次回答及标签为终点,多来源评估要求 10 次采样中出现全部相关标签;没有 episode 级停止条件。
  • 失败与回放审计:尚未确认官方逐失败记录、变换后语料、代码、检查点、不可变来源版本或完整配置。
  • 结果解释:高追踪率或拒答率只评估训练得到的接口,不能当作数据质量、因果血缘或开放发布完整性的证明。
  • Track 用途:该工作提供来源感知的构造配方和审计清单,但没有交付可回放的公开数据集。

value.html: Ordinary mode emits the task response. Diagnostic mode emits that response plus one dataset-level provenance tag. Remediation mode emits a standardized refusal when the requested quarantine tag matches the record source and otherwise retains the task response.

value_zh.html: Ordinary 模式发出任务回复。Diagnostic 模式发出该回复外加一个数据集级溯源标签。Remediation 模式在所请求的隔离标签与记录来源匹配时发出标准化拒绝，否则保留任务回复。

value.html: The main five-dataset study retains existing dataset targets and adds provenance and control labels. GPT-4o-mini synthesizes single-source QA pairs only for the QuoteSum study, and Llama-3.1-70B constructs only the semantic-perturbation evaluation set.

value.html: An offline two-stage optimization pipeline: instruction tuning on four heterogeneous datasets, then GRPO alignment on WMDP, with tracing and remediation objectives added to ordinary task training. The data object is not a multi-step debugging episode and contains no tool execution, environment observation, or persisted runtime state.

value_zh.html: 离线两阶段优化流水线：在四个异构数据集上指令微调，然后在 WMDP 上做 GRPO 对齐，并将溯源与修复目标加入 ordinary 任务训练。该数据对象不是多步调试 episode，且不含工具执行、环境观测或持久运行时状态。

value.html: Tracing is evaluated by exact-match Tracing Success Rate against known source tags; remediation is evaluated with an intervention matrix of refusal rates. Free-form utility uses Llama-3-70B-Instruct as judge, while WMDP and academic benchmark utility use exact match. The Stage 2 GRPO reward implementation is unknown, and no execution feedback is part of the reported record schema.

value_zh.html: 溯源以对照已知来源标签的精确匹配 Tracing Success Rate 评测；修复以拒绝率干预矩阵评测。自由形式效用使用 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 作为评审模型，而 WMDP 与学术基准效用使用精确匹配。Stage 2 GRPO 奖励实现未知，所报告记录 schema 不含执行反馈。

value.html: The main diagnostic interface produces one response and tag in one forward pass. Evaluation counts tracing success when the ground-truth tag is emitted; the two-source study requires all relevant tags to appear at least once across ten sampled outputs. Remediation seeks refusal on the quarantined source and ordinary generation elsewhere. No episodic training stop condition is reported.

value_zh.html: 主诊断接口在一次前向传播中产生一条回复与标签。评测在发出真值标签时计为溯源成功；双源研究要求所有相关标签在十个采样输出中至少各出现一次。修复寻求对隔离来源拒绝、其余处 ordinary 生成。未报告 episodic 训练停止条件。

value.html: For each source instruction-response pair, create an ordinary example and a diagnostic example whose target appends the source tag. For remediation, sample a control tag and train a refusal target when it matches the true source; otherwise retain the ordinary response.

value_zh.html: 对每个源指令-回复对，创建一个 ordinary 示例和一个目标追加来源标签的 diagnostic 示例。对于修复，采样一个控制标签，并在其与真实来源匹配时训练拒绝目标；否则保留 ordinary 回复。

value.html: Each source receives one dedicated tag. The QuoteSum study trains on isolated single-source pairs, then evaluates queries requiring two sources by aggregating tags across ten generations. The control-tag sampling distribution and ordinary-to-diagnostic example ratio are unknown.

value_zh.html: 每个来源获得一个专用标签。QuoteSum 研究在隔离的单源对上训练，然后通过在十次生成中聚合标签来评测需要两个来源的查询。控制标签采样分布与 ordinary-to-diagnostic 示例比例未知。

items: The method requires control of training and a known source mixture; it cannot be attached retroactively to a frozen black-box model.
The primary unit is an instruction-response record with source labels, not a debugging episode with actions, observations, execution feedback, and a runtime terminal state.
The paper does not release per-example failure records that connect a bad output, its diagnostic tag, the selected remediation, and a replay result.
Replayability is limited by absent official code, checkpoints, transformed records, immutable dataset revisions, and full training configuration.
Dataset-level tags do not establish record-level causality, and overlapping sources may make a unique source label conceptually ambiguous.
Training emits one tag per sequence; multi-source recovery depends on repeated stochastic sampling and its success definition.
Later fine-tuning can weaken or spoof the learned tag mapping, while self-reported tags are not independently authenticated evidence.
The developer trigger and quarantine tags create an access-control and misuse surface that the paper does not operationally secure.
Scaling to very many fine-grained or overlapping sources may introduce capacity pressure and tag interference.
Free-form utility depends on one model judge, whose rubric, calibration, and disagreement analysis are unknown.
Table 5 reports non-trivial Llama-based utility drops, including 58.57 to 52.11 on MMLU and 79.18 to 73.55 on ARC-Challenge.
Decontamination, source revision pinning, filtering, core optimization hyperparameters, and the Stage 2 GRPO reward implementation are unknown.
该方法需要控制训练并已知来源混合物；不能事后附加到冻结的黑盒模型。
基本单元是带来源标签的指令-回复记录，而非带动作、观测、执行反馈与运行时终态的调试 episode。
论文未发布将错误输出、其 diagnostic 标签、所选修复与回放结果相连的逐例失败记录。
可回放性受限于缺失官方代码、检查点、变换记录、不可变数据集修订与完整训练配置。
数据集级标签并不确立记录级因果，重叠来源可能使唯一来源标签在概念上含糊。
训练每条序列发出一个标签；多源恢复依赖于重复随机采样及其成功定义。
后续微调可削弱或伪造所学标签映射，而自报标签不是经独立认证的证据。
开发者触发与隔离标签构成访问控制与误用面，论文未在操作上加以保护。
扩展到非常多细粒度或重叠来源可能引入容量压力与标签干扰。
自由形式效用依赖于一个评审模型，其评分标准、校准与分歧分析未知。
表 5 报告不可忽略的基于 Llama 的效用下降，包括 MMLU 上 58.57 降至 52.11，以及 ARC-Challenge 上 79.18 降至 73.55。
去污染、来源修订固定、过滤、核心优化超参数与 Stage 2 GRPO 奖励实现未知。

value.html: Known source dataset and training stage -> assign a source tag -> construct ordinary, diagnostic-tagged, and control-tagged training variants -> sequential instruction tuning and GRPO -> developer-triggered source self-report or source-targeted refusal. This is designed dataset-level lineage, not authenticated proof that one record caused one output.
